AI Video Editor Tool — Version 1.0.0

- Initial release: Edit raw video footage into polished, shareable clips using AI-powered cloud processing.
- Supports MP4, MOV, AVI, and WebM files up to 500MB; exports 1080p MP4s.
- Simple authentication with automatic free token provisioning (100 credits, 7-day validity).
- Handles a wide range of user requests: editing, trimming, transitions, overlays, credits check, and exporting.
- Clear action mapping for common video editing tasks and prompt-driven workflow.
- Robust error handling and transparent cloud processing pipeline.
